# Armsys UI 2

> Framework-independent, dark-first design system by Armsys Technology for websites, documentation, admin panels, monitoring tools, embedded widgets and Electron apps. Plain HTML classes (`aui-*`), CSS tokens (`--aui-*`) and data-attribute behaviours (`data-aui-*`), scoped to `.aui`.

## Start here

- [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt): everything in one file — rules, tokens, components with markup, JS API, recipes
- [AI usage rules](AI_GUIDE.md)
- [Machine-readable index](ai/index.json)

- npm: `@armsys-tech/ui` (ESM, CJS, TypeScript)
